# LEI parent relationship: lei-relationship (LEIR)

One consolidation relationship from GLEIF's level 2 data: the child, its direct or ultimate parent, status and periods. One row per lei parent relationship, keyed by RELATIONSHIP_ID. Read by the **gleif** pack's connector `gleif-store` (table `<root>/gleif/lei-relationship/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-25 from GLEIF LEI records, relationship records and mapping files (tools/publicdata/gleif.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 9,347 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-relationship/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `RELATIONSHIP_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `RELATIONSHIP_ID`, `LEVEL`, `CHILD_ENTITY`, `PARENT_ENTITY`, `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## Sub-types

The rows come in 2 sub-types, recognised by `LEVEL`. Each has its own most complete record below; the fields every sub-type's record has are in one shared table first.

| Sub-type | Recognised by | Rows | Sample from | Section |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Direct** | `LEVEL` `Direct` | 7,653 | test data | [Direct](#direct) |
| **Ultimate** | `LEVEL` `Ultimate` | 1,694 | test data | [Ultimate](#ultimate) |

## Fields every sub-type has

The example is from the **Direct** record.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^LEIREL-` | `"LEIREL-0292001381F1R1IB5B85-DIRECT"` |
| `LEVEL` | string | required | Direct (the child's direct parent) or Ultimate (its ultimate parent). | one of `Direct`, `Ultimate` | `"Direct"` |
| `CHILD_ENTITY` | string | required | The child in the relationship: an LEI of the lei-entity kind (20 characters). | pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`; links to `lei-entity` | `"0292001381F1R1IB5B85"` |
| `PARENT_ENTITY` | string | required | The parent in the relationship (direct or ultimate, per LEVEL): an LEI of the lei-entity kind. | pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`; links to `lei-entity` | `"2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41"` |
| `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS` | string | required | Whether the relationship holds: ACTIVE or INACTIVE (GLEIF relationship status). | — | `"ACTIVE"` |
| `START` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the relationship started (the GLEIF relationship record's period start), YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2006-01-25"` |
| `PERIODS` | array of objects | required | The relationship's other periods in GLEIF (the accounting period and the document filing period of the consolidation), one element each: TYPE, START and END. | — | [1 objects] |
| `PERIODS[].TYPE` | string | required | The period's type in lower case: accounting period or document filing period. | one of `accounting period`, `document filing period` | `"accounting period"` |
| `PERIODS[].START` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in over 99% of `PERIODS[]` entries) | The first day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; absent when GLEIF gives none. | — | `"2017-01-01"` |
| `PERIODS[].END` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 90% of `PERIODS[]` entries) | The end of the period (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when it is open. | — | `"2017-12-31"` |
| `ACCOUNTING_STANDARD` | string | optional (filled in 44% of rows) | The accounting standard of the consolidation the relationship is based on (IFRS, US_GAAP, OTHER_ACCOUNTING_STANDARD), comma-separated when several. | one of `IFRS`, `OTHER_ACCOUNTING_STANDARD`, `US_GAAP` | `"IFRS"` |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | string | required | The relationship record's registration status in GLEIF (PUBLISHED, LAPSED...). | one of `LAPSED`, `PUBLISHED` | `"PUBLISHED"` |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the relationship record was first registered with GLEIF, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2016-07-14"` |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date GLEIF's relationship record was last changed, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-07-27"` |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the relationship record must be renewed by, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2027-07-13"` |
| `LEI_GROUP` | string | required | The child's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent, the id of the computed lei-group kind. | links to `lei-group` | `"2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41"` |

## One record of each sub-type

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `RELATIONSHIP_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `RELATIONSHIP_ID`, `LEVEL`, `CHILD_ENTITY`, `PARENT_ENTITY`, `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS`, `START`, `PERIODS`, `REGISTRATION_STATUS`, `INITIAL_REGISTRATION`, `LAST_UPDATE`, `NEXT_RENEWAL`, `LEI_GROUP` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `RELATIONSHIP_ID` per snapshot.
- `RELATIONSHIP_ID` matches `^LEIREL-`.
